name: Park Hyatt Tokyo
positioning: Hotel on the upper floors of Kenzo Tange's Shinjuku Park Tower in Shinjuku, on the west side of Tokyo, reopened in December 2025 after a renovation
best_for: Fans of the film Lost in Translation who want to stay where it was shot
Travelers who want a Shinjuku base with a library, jazz bar and Mt. Fuji views from the dining rooms
Families, since kids under 12 stay free and cribs and high chairs are available

facts.text: Park Hyatt Tokyo occupies the 39th to 52nd floors of Shinjuku Park Tower, in Shinjuku on the west side of Tokyo.
Shinjuku Park Tower was designed by Pritzker Prize-winner Kenzo Tange.
Rooms feature curated artwork, bespoke furnishings and views of Tokyo.
Club On The Park is a two-story skylit spa and fitness center.
The indoor pool at Club On The Park has panoramic views of Tokyo and Mt. Fuji through floor-to-ceiling glass walls.
New York Bar has nightly jazz performances with a Tokyo night view as the backdrop.
Girandole by Alain Ducasse is a French brasserie with a double-level collage of 144 black-and-white photographs by Vera Mercer.
The Peak Lounge & Bar serves afternoon tea in a glass atrium surrounded by a bamboo grove with views of Mt. Fuji.
A complimentary shuttle runs daily between the hotel's main entrance and Shinjuku station every 30 minutes.
The hotel reopened on December 9, 2025 after a 19-month renovation.
Cribs, high chairs and kids' menus are available, and kids under 12 stay free.
Meiji Jingu shrine in Yoyogi Park is a 15-20 minute walk south.

highlights.text: The hotel featured in the 2003 film Lost in Translation.
New York Grill has an open kitchen, live jazz, a 360-degree Tokyo view and murals by Italian artist Valerio Adami.
The Library on the 41st floor holds more than 2,000 hand-selected books.
On a clear winter day, Mt. Fuji can be seen from each dining table at Kozue.

considerations.text: 1 King Bed rooms on the 43rd and 44th floors have an obstructed view and no city view.
The pool is not available to kids under three.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
